document.abstract: This standard defines the object data format for the exchange of DV-based audio, data, and compressed video (which data structure is defined in SMPTE 314M) over the common layer defined in SMPTE 354M. The standard covers the transmission of audio, compressed video, and subcode data with DV-based 25-Mb/s and 50-Mb/s data structures for 525/60 and 625/50 systems and the transmission of the header data of serial data transport interface defined in SMPTE 305.2M.
